upload.title: 퇴사 다음 날, 알람이 울지 않았다 | 평일 오후 세 시 #shorts
upload.description:
알람이 울지 않는 아침.
넥타이는 옷장 속에서 잠이 들었습니다.

카프카 『변신』의 그레고르처럼, 퇴사 다음 날 나는 벌레가 된 것만 같았습니다.
그런데 평일 오후 세 시, 처음 보는 햇살 아래서 딸아이가 물었습니다. "아빠 오늘 회사 안 가?"
오늘은 너한테 출근했어.

🎵 평일 오후 세 시 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 회사 대신 처음 '출근'한 곳은 어디였나요? 댓글로 들려주세요. 다음 노래가 됩니다.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

shots.plate: a small Korean apartment bedroom in soft morning light seen at eye level, an unmade bed with a white blanket, a low wooden nightstand beside the bed with a tiny palm-sized round alarm clock on it showing half past seven, thin curtains glowing with sunlight
shots.motion: the man stands still and glances at the tiny silent alarm clock on the nightstand, the thin curtains sway softly in the morning breeze, dust floats in the sunlight

shots.plate: an open wooden wardrobe in a Korean apartment bedroom, a row of neckties and white shirts and dark suits hanging inside, morning light from the side
shots.motion: the man stands still in front of the open wardrobe looking at the hanging neckties, the neckties sway gently, morning light shifts slowly on the wall

shots.plate: a dim Korean apartment bedroom at late morning with the curtains half closed, a rumpled bed with a thick blanket, a sunny windowsill with a small potted plant and a tiny brown beetle on the sill
shots.motion: the man stands by the rumpled bed with a tired sigh, a tiny brown beetle slowly crawls along the sunny windowsill, the curtain moves a little

shots.plate: a quiet empty Korean apartment living room at midday, a sofa, a low table with a cold cup of coffee, a wall clock, children's school bags gone from their hooks, flat grey light
shots.motion: the man stands alone in the silent living room and lowers his shoulders, the wall clock's second hand ticks, the light slowly brightens through the window

shots.plate: a bright Korean apartment complex walkway on a sunny weekday afternoon seen at eye level, golden ginkgo trees, warm sunlight and long soft shadows, flower beds, a clear blue sky, nobody on the path
shots.motion: the man looks up into the warm afternoon sunlight with surprise, golden ginkgo leaves float down around him, branches sway gently

shots.plate: a small cozy Korean apartment playground on a sunny afternoon seen at eye level, a low red slide and a sandbox right behind, golden ginkgo trees and apartment buildings in the back
shots.motion: the two children laugh and bounce happily in front of the slide, the man watches them with a soft smile, golden leaves drift down

shots.plate: in front of the gate of a Korean elementary school on a quiet sunny afternoon, a red brick school building and an empty schoolyard behind the closed fence, golden ginkgo trees, an empty sidewalk
shots.motion: the little girl tilts her head and looks up at her father with curious eyes, the father smiles warmly and nods, ginkgo leaves fall, the background stays calm and empty

shots.plate: a quiet Korean neighborhood sidewalk lined with golden ginkgo trees on a sunny afternoon, small shops and a stationery store, warm long shadows
shots.motion: the father and his little daughter walk side by side along the sidewalk, the girl swings her arms happily, golden leaves fall around them

shots.plate: a sunny Korean apartment kitchen in the morning, breakfast on the table, a frying pan with eggs on the stove, a window with morning sun, a silent alarm clock on the counter
shots.motion: steam rises from the frying pan, the children laugh and chatter, the man smiles at them warmly, morning sunlight fills the kitchen

shots.plate: a walking path along a small stream in a Korean city park on a sunny afternoon, reeds and golden trees by the water, a stepping-stone bridge, apartment buildings far behind
shots.motion: the family stands together by the stream laughing, the wife leans toward her husband, the children point at the water, reeds sway in the wind

shots.plate: an apartment complex playground at golden sunset in Korea, empty swings, long warm shadows, golden ginkgo trees
shots.motion: the father and daughter stand together in the golden sunset light and smile at each other, the empty swings sway gently in the breeze

shots.plate: a window of a Korean apartment at sunset seen from inside, warm orange sky over the apartment complex, a child's crayon drawing of a smiling dad taped to the glass
shots.motion: the man stands still by the window and gazes at the warm sunset sky with a calm face, clouds drift slowly, the sky glows orange
